description:
Configure and run a Rotor BEM Simulation for the loaded wind turbine model such that the blade tip speed does not exceed 75 m/s. 

Starting with the IEA_RWT sample project loaded:
1. Find the Rotor Radius (in meters) in the Rotor Design module.
2. Calculate the maximum RPM corresponding to a 75 m/s tip speed limit (Formula: v = omega * R).
3. Create a new BEM Simulation with: Wind Speed 5-15 m/s (step 1), and Fixed Rotational Speed set to your calculated maximum RPM.
4. Run the simulation.
5. Save the project to '/home/ga/Documents/projects/tip_limited_sim.wpa'.
6. Create a report file '/home/ga/Documents/tip_speed_report.txt' with the format:
   Rotor Radius: [value] m
   Max Tip Speed: 75 m/s
   Calculated RPM: [value]
   Power at 10m/s: [value] kW (or MW)
